description.p: GitGud is a fast, native Git GUI built with Electron and Angular. It provides an intuitive interface for managing Git repositories with branch visualization, commit history, staging area management, interactive rebase, diff viewer, and more.

ul.li: Side-by-side and inline diff viewer powered by Monaco Editor
Interactive staging and unstaging of changes
Push, pull, fetch, and remote management
Aggregate the selected commits into one card with a timeline
Context menu on a commit's files
Show a loader on the update message button while rewording
Show days instead of hours when last fetch is over 24h ago
Undo the deletion of a remote branch or tag
Undo stash, branch and tag actions
Derive undo / redo from the reflog instead of toggling the last action
Save settings on modal blur (not only fields blur)
Download the package matching the installed format on Linux

description.p: Improved draw performance and multi-size desktop icons.
